lesson.subtitle: Lesson 10 -- You Should Try This
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Catarina | Lesson 10 -- You Should Try This

listenings.text: Okay, three things, quickly. First, the series. You should definitely watch it, and I mean definitely. But skip the first two episodes, they are slow and everybody says the same thing. Start at episode three and you will be addicted by the weekend. Second, that song I sent you last night. Just give it a try, it is three minutes, you have three minutes. And third, there is a podcast about history that I am really into at the moment. You might like it. Honestly, that one depends on whether you find history boring or not. Tell me what you think.

Right, a few words before test week, and I will keep it short. There is one thing you should definitely do, and it is not studying more. It is sleeping. At least seven hours, every night of that week. Everything else works better after that. Second, you could try studying with a friend, but only if you actually study. If you talk for an hour and read two pages, do it alone. And finally, the thing I do not think anyone should do: starting the night before. It might feel productive. It never is. Good luck, all of you.

items.situation: Your best friend is bored tonight. Recommend one thing, strongly.
Someone you barely know asks for a recommendation. Go softer.
Ask your teacher for two recommendations, and ask why.
A friend wants to start a series that is sixteen episodes long. Make it easier for them.
tips: Give it a try -- one episode.

items.situation: Somebody recommends something you really did not enjoy. Say so politely.
tips: You might like it more than I did.
